title: 第11章 李行歌 先让他们替我保管第12章 夺取气血丹
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 翌日。
万宝阁拍卖会如期举行。
在李延昭的带领下，一大早，一行人便向着万宝阁进发。
约莫半个时辰后，众人来到了万宝阁外。
出示了请柬后，在迎宾侍女的带领下，踏入了其中。
作为升龙府最大的拍卖场，万宝阁占地不可谓不广。
走入其中，首先映入眼帘的是一片开阔的青砖广场。
整个广场呈现一个碗的形状，李行歌粗略估计，能容纳上万人。
在周围，则如苍松般屹立着一个个精壮的青袍武士。
他们目不斜视，手扶弯刀，时刻保持着着高度的戒备。
这些青袍武士，最低也有着锻体境的修为。
甚至，在某些角落，李行歌还嗅到了几丝危险的气息。
“不愧是升龙府最大的拍卖场，果然深不可测。”
李行歌心中暗暗道。
能让万宝阁主动发出请柬的，都是万宝阁眼中的大客户。
大客服的待遇自然不一样，有着专属的贵宾间。
李行歌自然也不例外。
迎宾侍女将李行歌一行人带到了一间名叫地字二十九号的贵宾间中。
房间内，已经准备了各种价值不菲的水果，以及精致的点心。
甚至还有两名面容清秀，穿着清爽的侍女全程服侍。
这一幕。
不知为何，总觉得有点眼熟。
李行歌的嘴角，勾起了一丝莫名的笑意。
李行歌撩袍落座，身旁，两名娇俏的侍女温柔的献上了瓜果与点心。
坐在这里看，可以将拍卖场的一切尽收眼底。
随着客人的陆续进场，场面一时间变得喧嚣了起来。
但好在，李行歌所在的贵宾间不受影响。
等待了约莫半刻钟后。
拍卖会，正式开始。
一名身姿窈窕，面容娇美的女子在一名青袍老者的陪同下，缓缓登上了拍卖台。
李行歌的目光瞬间被吸引。
不是因为貌美的女子，而是那个青袍老者。
他从那青袍老者身上感受到了一种极度危险的气息。
这是李行歌突破气血境后，从未有过的感觉。
这老者，是一个极其可怕的高手。
“诸位贵客，自四面八方而来，欢迎来到万宝阁。”
“我是万宝阁的首席拍卖师王萱萱，本次拍卖会很荣幸由我主持！”
content_en:
The next day.
The Wanbao Pavilion auction was held as scheduled.
Under the leadership of Li Yanzhao, the group headed towards Wanbao Pavilion early in the morning.
About half an hour later, everyone arrived outside Wanbao Pavilion.
After showing the invitation, he stepped inside under the leadership of the welcoming maid.
As the largest auction house in Shenglong Mansion, Wanbao Pavilion occupies a large area.
When you walk in, the first thing you see is an open blue brick square.
The entire square is in the shape of a bowl, and Li Xingge roughly estimates that it can accommodate tens of thousands of people.
Around them, strong green-robed warriors stood like pine trees.
They looked intently, held scimitars in their hands, and were always on high alert.
These green-robed warriors have at least the cultivation level of the body training realm.
Even, in some corners, Li Xingge smelled a hint of danger.
"It is indeed the largest auction house in Shenglong Mansion. It is indeed unfathomable."
Li Xingge thought to himself.
Those who can make Wanbao Pavilion take the initiative to send out invitations are all big customers in Wanbao Pavilion's eyes.
The treatment of the big customer service is naturally different, and there is an exclusive VIP room.
Li Xingge is naturally no exception.
The welcoming maid took Li Xingge and his party to a VIP room named Dizi No. 29.
In the room, various valuable fruits and exquisite snacks have been prepared.
There were even two maids with delicate faces and crisply dressed clothes serving the whole process.
This scene.
I don't know why, but it always feels familiar.
An inexplicable smile appeared at the corner of Li Xingge's mouth.
Li Xingge lifted his robe and sat down. Beside him, two pretty maids tenderly offered melons, fruits and snacks.
Sitting here and watching, you can have a panoramic view of everything in the auction house.
As guests entered one after another, the scene suddenly became noisy.
But fortunately, the VIP room where Li Xingge was staying was not affected.
After waiting for about half a quarter of an hour.
The auction officially begins.
A graceful woman with a delicate face slowly stepped onto the auction stage, accompanied by an old man in a green robe.
Li Xingge's eyes were instantly attracted.
Not because of the beautiful woman, but because of the old man in green robe.
He felt an extremely dangerous aura from the old man in green robe.
This is something Li Xingge has never felt since he broke through the Qi and Blood Realm.
This old man is an extremely terrifying master.
"Dear distinguished guests, coming from all directions, welcome to Wanbao Pavilion."
"I am Wang Xuanxuan, the chief auctioneer of Wanbao Pavilion, and I am honored to host this auction!"
